name: Windows Settings Manager Lite
blocker: Windows Control Center pivot is implemented but fresh exact-head automation and physical Stream Deck/Windows QA are still required. Lite also remains commercially blocked until Pro publishes first and verified direct Lite/Pro Marketplace URLs/IDs pass the strict shipping routing audit.
final_boundary: Pass fresh exact-head build/tests/Windows backend smoke/Elgato validation/package and the Control Center physical QA matrix, publish Pro first, record verified direct Lite/Pro Marketplace URLs/IDs, pass tools/lite_pro_audit.py --shipping windows-settings-manager-lite, then move Lite to READY_TO_SHIP.
release_gate: Windows backend smoke including Control Center snapshot shape
Lock / Sleep / Power Plan / Keep Awake physical validation
Previous / Next virtual desktop physical validation and readback
Stream Deck restart and Windows reboot validation
strict Lite to Pro Marketplace routing audit after Pro publication
bundled profile integrity across seven device families

upsell.release_order: publish Pro first, then record direct Pro and Lite Marketplace URLs before Lite publication

commercial_release_boundary: After technical/physical QA passes, publish Pro first. Lite remains BLOCKED until Pro is published, both exact direct Marketplace URLs/IDs are recorded in products/lite-pro-map.json, the rebuilt Lite package contains the exact Pro URL, and tools/lite_pro_audit.py --shipping windows-settings-manager-lite passes.
